title: Деньги в урне и звонок Шефу  (Money in the Trash Bin and Calling the Chef)

segments.t: On the second ransom call, Rodion scolds Nastya's father for bringing Kostya along and instructs him to drop the money into a trash bin around the corner. Back at the restaurant, Max calls Chef Barinov in desperation to tell him the dining room is overflowing.

Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.

'You should not have brought Konstantin along with you.' Rodion follows up plainly beside Barinov, making his position completely clear.
'Yes, hello.' Barinov promptly chooses this direct affirmation at this moment using "da" ("yes") — a crisp "da" ("yes") that confirms the point without extra words.
'We know everything that happened.' Holding firm directly in the exchange, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 4 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'How did you find out?' Barinov quizzes promptly before Rodion can change the subject.
'There is a shop on the other side of the street.' Underscoring a shop at once, Rodion chooses "magazin" ("shop") so Barinov gets the point right away.
'Right there, around the corner to the right, is a trash bin.' Addressing the corner on the spot, Barinov links the Russian words directly in the present with no word for "am", "is", or "are" needed.
'Put the money inside it and walk away.' Rodion opens up firmly toward Barinov, letting the remark speak for itself.
'Rodion Sergeyevich?' Jumping in warmly at once, Barinov keeps normal statement word order here, turning the line into a question for Rodion purely through rising pitch.

'Otherwise I am going to be late for work already.' Focusing on the job right here, Rodion centers the thought on "opazdyvayu" ("am running late", from "opazdyvat") without wasting a word.
'All by myself? Well?' Barinov tests earnestly before Rodion can change the subject.
'Only for your sake.' Cutting in warmly with Barinov, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 3 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'At the Claude Monet restaurant.' Addressing the restaurant around Rodion, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 4 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'Because the thing is.' Rodion answers pointedly with a nod, testing Barinov's reaction in the middle of the exchange.

That wraps up this scene as rodion instructs Nastya's father to drop the ransom in a corner trash bin and leave, while Max tries calling Chef Barinov for help with the packed restaurant. See you next time!
